author: Michael Larabel
description: Well, here's an unexpected surprise... A new version of the Linux kernel patches for DXGKRNL were posted today for that DirectX kernel driver that began a few years ago for supporting Windows Subsystem For Linux (WSL) use-cases. This comes four years to the month after the prior version was posted and without much excitement for getting it into the mainline Linux kernel...
title: Microsoft's DXGKRNL Driver Updated For Linux - Many Changes After Four Years

author: Michael Larabel
description: Thunderbird announced today the availability of their public roadmaps where they are making it easier for end-users to comprehend what they are currently working on for this mail client not only for the desktop builds but also their Android and iOS versions too...
title: Thunderbird Looks To Finalize Its Exchange Support, Refresh The Calendar UI

author: Michael Larabel
description: AMD today sent out another batch of AMDGPU kernel graphics driver and AMDKFD kernel compute driver changes to DRM-Next ahead of next month's Linux 7.1 merge window...
title: AMD Preps More GFX12.1 Enablement For Linux 7.1, Initial VCN 5.0.2 & JPEG 5.0.2 IP

author: Michael Larabel
title: Wayland 1.25 Released With Color Management Now Fully Documented

author: Michael Larabel
description: With this week's release of Blender 5.1 I have begun benchmarking it on different CPUs and GPUs. In this article is an initial look at the positive impact Blender 5.1 is having on CPU-based rendering performance on Linux.
title: Blender 5.1 Delivers Some Nice Gains For CPU Rendering Performance On Linux

author: Michael Larabel
description: Version 0.27 of GNUnet is now available for this free software framework for constructing decentralized, peer-to-peer networking. But it comes with some big caveats before use...
title: GNUnet 0.27 Released For Those With "Some Reasonable Pain Tolerance"

author: Michael Larabel
description: The last release of Llamafile was back in May and it's led me recently to wonder if Mozilla was slowly abandoning this AI project like they had done in the past to DeepSpeech and other software projects. Fortunately, that's not the case and out today is Llamafile 0.10 with some big updates...
title: Mozilla Releases Llamafile 0.10 To Enhance Their AI Offering For Easy-To-Use LLMs

author: Michael Larabel
description: The OpenGL API is still seeing new extensions introduced in 2026. Merged today to the OpenGL Registry is a new extension intended to help Wine usage for 32-bit Windows games/apps on 64-bit Linux systems...
title: OpenGL Lands New Extension To Benefit Wine

author: Michael Larabel
description: It's been a while since most of you probably thought about the Opera web browser, but these days they have been catering their "Opera GX" web browser to gamers. Today they have finally delivered this Opera GX gaming-focused browser for Linux users...
title: Opera GX Web Browser Released For Linux

author: Michael Larabel
description: The fourth iteration of patches implementing Virtual Swap Space for Linux were sent out on Wednesday. This stems from ideas going back years for an abstraction to better separate a swap entry from its physical backing storage...
title: Virtual Swap Space Patches Updated For Improving Linux's Swap Design

author: Michael Larabel
description: Drew Fustini sent out DeviceTree patches this past weekend for enabling the HDMI display controller on the T-Head TH1520 RISC-V SoC. Additionally, there's a patch for lighting up the HDMI display support on the LicheePi 4A RISC-V board...
title: Linux 7.1 Should See Working HDMI Support For The Lichee Pi 4A RISC-V Board

author: Michael Larabel
description: With Ubuntu 26.04 LTS quickly approaching release next week, Canonical is beginning more of their road-mapping for Ubuntu 26.10 and beyond. To help in plotting future work, Canonical is interested in feedback for features or improvements that developers/users would like to see around their Mir project...
title: Canonical Collecting Wish List Ideas For Improving Mir
